# uboot_env v1.0.2 - Table of Contents

> Read and write to U-Boot environment blocks

## Pages

- [UBootEnv](https://uboot-env.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://uboot-env.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [UBootEnv](https://uboot-env.hexdocs.pm/UBootEnv.md): UBootEnv reads and writes U-Boot environment blocks
- [UBootEnv.Config](https://uboot-env.hexdocs.pm/UBootEnv.Config.md): Utilities for reading the U-Boot's `fw_env.config` file.

- [UBootEnv.IO](https://uboot-env.hexdocs.pm/UBootEnv.IO.md): Functions for reading and writing raw blocks to storage
- [UBootEnv.Location](https://uboot-env.hexdocs.pm/UBootEnv.Location.md): Environment block location

- [UBootEnv.Serializer](https://uboot-env.hexdocs.pm/UBootEnv.Serializer.md): Encode and decode a U-Boot environment data
